visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a beige bucket hat and a black windbreaker stands on a grey sandy beach under an overcast sky. She smiles broadly while looking slightly off-camera, with ocean waves breaking in the background. (2) The camera zooms in on the woman's face as she speaks enthusiastically, using wide hand gestures. A red location pin icon appears on screen briefly. (3) The woman performs a series of stylized hand movements, similar to dance or yoga poses, looking directly into the lens with a playful expression. (4) Scene shifts to a man in a black hoodie filmed in a selfie-style close-up, followed by the woman standing next to two men wearing white construction gloves. They all show five fingers to the camera. (5) The woman is seen leaning over the sand, picking up a long, discarded rope. She holds one end to her ear like a phone. (6) Close-up shots show the woman using metal tongs to pick up bottle caps and plastic foam from the sand. (7) The setting changes to a shadowed area underneath a concrete bridge. The ground is covered in large amounts of driftwood, plastic bottles, and miscellaneous debris. The woman continues picking up trash and placing it into a large clear plastic bag.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog documenting a beach cleaning event in Wanli. By using a humorous and energetic presentation style, the creator turns a volunteer task into entertaining content, encouraging environmental participation through comedic social interactions and relatable moments.
